title: The Hidden Reason You Feel Restless After Sitting Too Long
hook: Sitting for hours, your body thinks you are in danger.

narration.text: Sitting for hours, your body thinks you are in danger.
It is not just boredom, it is your circulation slowing down.
Blood pools in your legs, reducing oxygen flow to your brain.
Your brain interprets this lack of fresh blood as a threat.
It triggers a primal fight or flight response, making you restless.
This urge to move is your body trying to restore proper blood flow.
Small movements, even wiggling your toes, can make a difference.
Have you noticed feeling this way after long periods of inactivity?

description: Ever wondered why you feel so antsy after sitting for a long time? It turns out your body has a fascinating way of responding to prolonged stillness. Discover the surprising link between circulation, your brain, and that restless feeling.
topic: Why you feel restless after sitting for a long time, explaining the body's need for movement and its effect on circulation.
